messages:
Nora (People Ops): Heads up 1026 handbook change: we're consolidating 'remote approval exceptions' and 'hybrid scheduling' into one short policy. Need wording sign-off + a lightweight compliance micro-training for people managers. Small ask: two reviewers for wording and one owner to run the manager RSVP + completion tracker.

Ben T: I can take wording review. timeline?

Nora (People Ops): Thanks Ben. Target to publish policy 2026-04-14. Reviews due by 2026-03-28 so localization/legal have time. Training drop-ins: 2026-04-02 and 2026-04-09.

Rina (Legal): I'll review EU-specific language. Note: avoid language that implies contractors are eligible for paid benefits. Keep "manager approval" flow explicit for country-specific labor rules.

Kai: Quick Q: will the policy change PTO accrual rules for remote days?

Nora (People Ops): No change to PTO accrual. This is purely about scheduling exceptions (e.g., overlapping shifts, on-call handoffs, temporary remote work beyond standard flex days). We'll add an example scenario.

Ben T: Wording pass started 10 comments inline. Suggested: rename "temporary remote exception" -> "manager-authorized remote exception".

Sam: I can own RSVP/completion tracker and handle manual follow-ups for managers who don't respond. Share the CSV header format and I'll wire up automations.

Nora (People Ops): Tracker CSV header:
```csv
manager_name,team,email,completed(yes/no),completion_ts,training_session,verifier,notes
```
Please keep email column so we can auto-email receipts.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled 10 days before first session and a follow-up reminder 48 hours after a manager RSVPs but has not marked completion.

Rina (Legal): Also flag: for DE/FR we should add a short sentence about temporary workplace assessments when remote exceeds X weeks. I'll comment on the draft.

Ben T: Added suggested phrasing to the doc. Kept examples concise.

Nora (People Ops): Great. Action owners: 1) Ben 10 Ben finalize wording by 2026-03-27; 2) Rina 10 legal localization review by 2026-03-29; 3) Sam 10 tracker + automations (RSVP + completion receipts) by 2026-03-30; 4) Nora publish 2026-04-14 and run post-publish nudge. I'll post the PR link here when opened.

Kai: FYI I'll flag any team-specific constraints (on-call rotations) to Sam so we can pre-populate the tracker for those managers.

Sam: thanks Kai. I'll seed the tracker with managers from eng and product and share the link.

Nora (People Ops): PR opened: https://git.company/handbook/policies/remote-exceptions-2026. Please add quick reviews.

PeopleOpsBot: Note: to ensure CSV exports work correctly, managers must use the exact header ordering above when adding rows.

Nora (People Ops): Closing loop 10: if anyone wants to be a backup trainer for the 4/9 session, volunteer now. (Sam is primary).
